began.sort: from the oldest to the newest, by the year they began
began.era: Drop each war into the century it began.
began.shot: In what year did {label} begin? It {hook}.

rows.label: World War II
rows.hook: pitted the Allies against Germany, Italy and Japan across nearly every continent
rows.description: 1939–1945 global conflict

rows.label: World War I
rows.hook: was sparked when an archduke was shot in Sarajevo, and was fought largely from muddy trenches
rows.description: 1914–1918 global conflict

rows.label: Vietnam War
rows.hook: saw the United States back the South against the communist North in Southeast Asia
rows.description: armed conflict in Vietnam, Laos, and Cambodia between North Vietnam and South Vietnam, from 1955 to 1975

rows.label: American Civil War
rows.hook: split the Union from the Confederacy and ended slavery in the United States
rows.description: 1861–1865 civil war in the United States between the North and the South over the enslavement of African-Americans

rows.label: Falklands War
rows.hook: saw Britain retake a group of South Atlantic islands after Argentina seized them
rows.description: undeclared war between Argentina and the United Kingdom in 1982

rows.label: Gulf War
rows.hook: saw a US-led coalition drive Iraqi forces out of Kuwait
rows.description: 1990–1991 conflict between Iraq and a 42-country coalition

rows.label: Korean War
rows.hook: was fought over a divided peninsula and ended in an armistice rather than a peace treaty
rows.description: war between North and South Korea, 1950–1953

rows.label: Iraq War
rows.hook: opened with a US-led invasion that toppled Saddam Hussein
rows.description: 2003–2011 war after an American-led invasion

rows.label: American Revolutionary War
rows.hook: won the thirteen colonies their independence from Britain
rows.description: 1775–1783 war between Great Britain and the Thirteen Colonies, which won independence as the United States of America

rows.label: War in Afghanistan
rows.hook: followed the attacks on New York's Twin Towers, with US-led forces fighting the Taliban
rows.description: armed conflict between NATO countries and Afghanistan from 2001 to 2021

rows.label: Soviet-Afghan War
rows.hook: saw Moscow's army bogged down fighting mujahideen rebels until it finally withdrew
rows.description: 1979–1989 war between the Soviet Union and Afghan insurgents

rows.label: Spanish Civil War
rows.hook: pitted Republicans against Franco's Nationalists and inspired Picasso's Guernica
rows.description: war between the Republicans and the Nationalists in Spain from 1936 to 1939

rows.label: Thirty Years' War
rows.hook: tore through the Holy Roman Empire and ended with the Peace of Westphalia
rows.description: war principally fought in Central Europe from 1618 to 1648

rows.label: Hundred Years' War
rows.hook: pitted England against France and made a heroine of Joan of Arc
rows.description: series of conflicts and wars between England and France between 1337 and 1453

rows.label: Seven Years' War
rows.hook: is often called the first global conflict, with Britain and France fighting on several continents
rows.description: global war among European powers (1756–1763)

rows.label: Wars of the Roses
rows.hook: was a fight for the English throne between the houses of Lancaster and York
rows.description: dynastic civil war in England from 1455 to 1487

rows.label: Crimean War
rows.hook: is remembered for the Charge of the Light Brigade and Florence Nightingale's nursing
rows.description: military conflict fought between October 1853 – March 1856

rows.label: Napoleonic Wars
rows.hook: saw a French emperor conquer much of Europe until his defeat at Waterloo
rows.description: 1803–1815 wars involving the French Empire

rows.label: Iran–Iraq War
rows.hook: was a grinding standoff between two Persian Gulf neighbours that ended with no clear winner
rows.description: 1980-1988 war between Iran and Iraq

rows.label: French and Indian War
rows.hook: was the North American front of Britain's worldwide struggle with France
rows.description: North American theatre of the worldwide Seven Years' War

rows.label: Mexican-American War
rows.hook: ended with the United States gaining California and much of the Southwest
rows.description: military conflict between the United States of America and Mexico from 1846 to 1848

rows.label: Second Boer War
rows.hook: pitted Britain against two Afrikaner republics in South Africa
rows.description: war between two Boer Republics (South African Republic and Orange Free State) and the United Kingdom

rows.label: Franco-Prussian War
rows.hook: ended with a united Germany proclaimed in the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles
rows.description: 1870–1871 military conflict of the Second French Empire versus Prussia and its allies

rows.label: Spanish–American War
rows.hook: saw the United States win Puerto Rico, Guam and the Philippines after fighting over Cuba
rows.description: 1898 conflict between Spain and the United States

rows.label: Russian Civil War
rows.hook: pitted the Bolshevik Reds against the Whites after the fall of the tsar
rows.description: multi-sided civil war in the former Russian Empire, November 1917-October 1922

rows.label: English Civil War
rows.hook: set Parliament against King Charles I and made Oliver Cromwell the country's ruler
rows.description: series of armed conflicts and political machinations between Parliamentarians and Royalists

rows.label: Russo-Japanese War
rows.hook: was the first modern conflict in which an Asian power beat a European one
rows.description: conflict between the Russian and Japanese empires from 1904 to 1905

rows.label: War of the Spanish Succession
rows.hook: was fought over who would inherit the throne in Madrid after a childless king died
rows.description: major European conflict (1700–1714) after the death of Charles II

rows.label: Winter War
rows.hook: saw Finland hold off a Soviet invasion in deep snow and bitter cold
rows.description: 1939–1940 war between the Soviet Union and Finland

rows.label: Peninsular War
rows.hook: saw Britain, Spain and Portugal fight Napoleon's armies across Iberia
rows.description: 1807–1814 conflict during the Napoleonic Wars

rows.label: Algerian War
rows.hook: won a North African country its independence from France
rows.description: war between France and the Algerian independence movement from 1954 to 1962

rows.label: Great Northern War
rows.hook: ended Sweden's reign as a major power and made Russia a force under Tsar Peter
rows.description: conflict between anti-Swedish coalition Led by Russia and Swedish empires in 1700–1721

rows.label: First Indochina War
rows.hook: ended French rule in Vietnam after the siege of Dien Bien Phu
rows.description: 1946–1954 French colonial war in Vietnam

rows.label: Greek War of Independence
rows.hook: freed Greece from Ottoman rule, with help from Britain, France and Russia
rows.description: Greek rebellion against the Ottoman Empire (1821–1829)

rows.label: First Sino-Japanese War
rows.hook: was fought over control of Korea and left Taiwan in Tokyo's hands
rows.description: 1894–1895 war between the Qing dynasty and the Empire of Japan over influence in Joseon, fought chiefly in Joseon

rows.label: Paraguayan War
rows.hook: pitted one small South American country against Brazil, Argentina and Uruguay
rows.description: large-scale conflict in South America (1864–1870)

rows.label: Eighty Years' War
rows.hook: won the Dutch their independence from Spanish rule
rows.description: 16th- and 17th-century Dutch revolt against the Habsburgs

rows.label: First Opium War
rows.hook: ended with China handing Hong Kong to Britain
rows.description: war between Great Britain and China in the 19th century

rows.label: Austro-Prussian War
rows.hook: lasted just seven weeks and left Berlin leading the northern German states
rows.description: 1866 military conflict between the Kingdom of Prussia and the Austrian Empire

rows.label: French Revolutionary Wars
rows.hook: pitted the new republic in Paris against Europe's crowned monarchies
rows.description: 1792–1802 series of conflicts between the French Republic and several European monarchies

rows.label: Second Italo-Ethiopian War
rows.hook: saw Mussolini's forces invade the African empire of Haile Selassie
rows.description: 1935-1936 war between Italy and Ethiopia

rows.label: Balkan Wars
rows.hook: saw Serbia, Greece, Bulgaria and Montenegro push the Ottomans out of most of Europe
rows.description: two consecutive wars in 1912 and 1913

rows.label: Anglo-Zulu War
rows.hook: saw a British army suffer a shock defeat at Isandlwana
rows.description: war between the British Empire and the Zulu Kingdom fought in the Zulu lands in South Africa in 1879

rows.label: Polish–Soviet War
rows.hook: turned on the Miracle on the Vistula, a famous victory outside Warsaw
rows.description: conflict between Poland and Soviet Russia following the First World War (February 1919 - March 1921)

rows.label: War of the Austrian Succession
rows.hook: was fought over whether Maria Theresa could inherit the Habsburg lands

rows.label: Italian Wars
rows.hook: saw France and Spain battle for control of Milan, Naples and the rest of the peninsula
rows.description: Wars in Italy from the 15th to 16th centuries

rows.label: Anglo-Zanzibar War
rows.hook: is famous as the shortest conflict ever recorded, over in under an hour
rows.description: colonial war by the United Kingdom in East-Africa

rows.label: First Boer War
rows.hook: saw Afrikaner farmers defeat the British at Majuba Hill
rows.description: military conflict in South Africa (1880–1881)
